name: VẠN VẬT — Video Design System
style: Scientific Editorial × Natural History Museum × Minimalist Infographic
colorRules: Keep graphic surfaces predominantly white or warm white.
Use botanical-teal (#397B72) for the main highlighted organism, process, or concept; mineral-blue (#83A7B4) and sand (#E3D8BE) as supporting accents.
Preserve natural colors in wildlife, landscape, geological, and astronomical footage.
Dark backgrounds used selectively for deep ocean, night-sky, or astronomy.
Avoid neon green, electric purple, rainbow gradients, and glowing outlines.
